messages.subject: Header Image
parts:
Hey everyone, I'm trying to put a logo in the header of my app instead of text. I'm not exactly sure how to go about it.
I'm not very familiar with html so the documentation has been kind of tough for me to find a solution for this problem.

I'm making a page with a side bar and some tabs.

thanks!

messages.author: 345c2051bc2163c4
messages.subject: Re: Header Image
parts:
in ui.R you can put this:
  headerPanel("",
              tags$head(
                tags$img(src="http://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/c/c1/Rlogo.png/200px-Rlogo.png", height="200px")
              )
  ),

messages.author: 345c2051bc2163c4
messages.subject: Re: Header Image
parts:
What you'll want to do is 
  1. create a folder named "www" in your Shiny App folder (the folder where your ui.R and server.R files reside)
  2. save the file as "plot.png" or whatever you want to name it
  3. change the tags$img to tags$img(src="plot.png", height="200px")
you don't need to put "www/plot.png" because it automatically looks in the www folder

messages.author: 345c2051bc2163c4
messages.subject: Re: Header Image
parts:
Apparently you need to use width="200px" or whatever instead of height. Sorry about that. The hard part if you want it your image on the server is putting the image into your www folder. I had success downloading images to the shiny server using the R command download.file()

You could put the image in the sidebarpanel instead of the head tag and then set width to 100%

Alternatively you can make the sidebar panel fixed. Here is an example where someone manually sets the dimensions: https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/shiny-discuss/3m7cq96mcBY
you then just set the width to be the same number of pixels as the sidebar
